title: Nerv Built-ins Registry
description: Schema for spec/builtins.yaml — wizard-readable metadata for in-process built-in hooks. Daemon dispatch source-of-truth lives in internal/hookpkg/builtins/registry.go; this file is wizard-only metadata. Every entry's `id` MUST match a registered builtins.All.Name (validated at wizard startup via builtins.Validate).

version.description: Schema version. Bumped in lockstep with builtins.schema.json when the entry shape changes.

builtins.description: Ordered list of built-in entries. Order is the wizard prompt order.

builtin_entry.description: One built-in's wizard metadata. NOTE: no `hook_template` field — built-ins dispatch in-process (wizard-onboarding ADR OQ2 resolution); wizard writes only `enabled` to the user config layer.

id.description: Unique slug. MUST match a registered builtins.All.Name in internal/hookpkg/builtins/registry.go.

description.description: One-line summary used as wizard list item / header.

prompt.description: Multi-line text shown on the wizard prompt screen for this built-in.

risk_level.description: Drives lipgloss color coding in the wizard. low = read-only, never blocks, no network calls. medium = may warn or rewrite; local side effects only. high = can block events or make network calls.

events.description: Nerv event names this built-in subscribes to. Values MUST appear in spec/events.yaml. Used for adapter-capability filtering.

requires_cli.description: CLI ids the built-in needs (e.g. claude, codex, copilot). Empty array = no filter (all CLIs); non-empty = wizard prompts only when adapters.Detect() reports an intersecting CLI.

event_name.description: Canonical nerv event name from spec/events.yaml. Keep this enum in sync with that file.
